messages:
Morgan (sec-eng): Quick sync — finalizing pen test retest for ACME. Need to lock: KMS rotation window, RBAC freeze, audit exports, and evidence handoff. Proposing Mon Apr 14 03:00-06:00 UTC for the active test window. Can we confirm blockers?
Priya (compliance): That slot looks ok. Can we avoid rotation between 02:30-03:30? We have nightly exports ending then.
Sam (infra): I can delay KMS rotation until after 06:30 if needed. But we need at least 48h notice to push the schedule in the key-management calendar.
Alex (sre): For RBAC, propose freeze at 00:00 UTC on the day with an "emergency change" escalation path. Documented rollback contact + JIRA cadence.
Jamie (oncall): Oncall ok with that. If something breaks during the window we will triage via #release-war-room and escalate to infra oncall.
Morgan (sec-eng): Can we standardize the evidence location and presigned link TTL? Compliance prefers 12h TTL and a read-only presigned folder.
pt-bot: Evidence room created: s3://redwood-pt/acme/retest-2026-04-14. Presigned URLs configured for 12h by default. Audit export snapshot scheduled to /exports/pt/acme/2026-04-14.tgz
Casey (devex): I'll post a short quickstart for assessors with how to download evidence and the hashes. Will include commands and the signed URL pattern.
Priya (compliance): Retention ask — set audit logs retention to 90 days for this engagement and also stream a copy to the compliance GCS bucket. Need proof-of-export before retest starts.
Sam (infra): Will run an export and share checksum. Quick note about KMS: if we do a key rotation in that window, any pre-signed URL generated earlier will fail. So generate presigned evidence after rotation completes OR use a different key/alias.
Morgan (sec-eng): Good catch. So plan: 1) freeze RBAC at 00:00 UTC 2) no KMS rotation during 02:30-03:30; rotation can happen after 06:30 if needed 3) presigned evidence generated AFTER rotation complete OR use alias 'pt-evidence' that we won't rotate.
Alex (sre): I can create ephemeral IAM roles for assessors with assume-role TTL = 8h. We'll log assume-role calls to CloudTrail and export to the evidence room.
Jamie (oncall): Also add a short runbook: how to revoke an ephemeral role immediately. I can draft it.
Morgan (sec-eng): Remediation owners: list below (short): CVE-2026-001 (web) -> @Casey; CVE-2026-007 (auth) -> @Sam; P3 infra config -> @Alex. We'll create a remediation board in JIRA and tag severity.
Casey (devex): Will prepare a reproducible repro package for each vuln and add a small test harness so assessors can validate fixes locally.
Priya (compliance): Acceptance criteria for retest: no P1 open, P2 <= 1 regression allowed (with mitigation), audit export verified, evidence checksums matched.
Sam (infra): Scheduling note: dry-run (no external testers) on Fri Apr 11 16:00 UTC to validate presigned links, assume-roles, and audit exports. Recommend everyone oncall for 30m.
Morgan (sec-eng): Please add the dry-run to calendar invite. I'll also post a concise checklist here.
Casey (devex): Draft checklist: 1) Confirm RBAC freeze 2) Validate ephemeral role assume and CloudTrail logs 3) Generate presigned evidence and check checksums 4) Verify audit export landed in GCS 5) Confirm KMS alias policy (no rotation)
pt-bot: Dry-run invite created for Fri Apr 11 16:00 UTC. Reminders sent to participants.
Alex (sre): One more: document the emergency bypass flow: create CHANGE with high priority, DM leads, oncall triages, use ephemeral-override role for urgent fixes, rotate keys after the window only.
Morgan (sec-eng): Sounds good. I'll convert this thread into a short runbook and post to the PT folder. If no objections, we'll lock the plan tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya (compliance): No objections from compliance.
Jamie (oncall): All set from oncall.
Sam (infra): Ok from infra pending the 48h rotation notice window.
Casey (devex): I'll publish assessor notes and the presigned link template after dry-run.
Morgan (sec-eng): Thanks all — tagging final action items in JIRA and closing this sync.
